scoring_justification: Checker recomputes Tc from the parameters using the exact decoration-iteration mapping and compares to the agent's reported values group‑wise; no pre‑computed gold needed.

outputs.description: Critical temperatures T_c (in units of k_B/J_I) for the specified parameter sets, computed via the exact decoration-iteration mapping. The hidden checker compares each T_c to a gold precomputed from the same mapping within a small absolute tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the scored artifact critical_temperatures.csv is required. The agent must implement the mapping and compute Tc; no intermediate artifacts are handed over. The parameter sweep ranges are exactly those specified in the step description.

steps.description: Group rows by (param, param_value); for each group compare the multiset of T_c values to the multiset recomputed from the exact mapping. Fraction of groups that match within tolerance.
